recipes.oracle_text: {2}{G}: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.

recipe_coverage: All reviewed variants of the declared Oracle-pinned recipe; exact payment, effect receipts, populated zones, both controllers where supported and snapshot replay.
